body:
White Gummy FOGER Switch Pro Kit is a complete starter or upgrade kit from Foger. It includes the device and its matching pod, so you can set up quickly and understand how the system works before you add accessories.

White Gummy FOGER Switch Pro Kit is listed at $16.99 in our Vape Kits range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Vape Kits](/shop/vape-kits/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name White Gummy Switch points to bold, confectionery-style flavor that stands out. Flavor is personal, so treat the description as a guide rather than a promise: how a profile tastes depends on your device, how you draw and what you vaped before.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Foger
- **Category:** Vape Kits
- **Flavor:** White Gummy Switch
- **Nicotine strength:** 50mg (5%)
- **Price:** $16.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Rechargeable battery:** charge over USB-C and keep using the same device instead of buying a new one each time.
- **Pod-based system:** makes it quick to change flavors or replace a pod without cleaning or rebuilding anything.
- **Simple operation:** a familiar draw-activated or one-button layout keeps day-to-day use easy to learn.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
White Gummy FOGER Switch Pro Kit suits adult vapers upgrading from disposables, those who want a reusable device with swappable pods, and gift buyers looking for a complete set that is ready to use.

## Using and caring for it
Charge the device fully before first use with a standard USB-C cable, seat the pod firmly until it clicks, and give a new pod a minute to saturate before you begin. Take short, steady draws, keep the pod connectors clean and dry, and store the kit upright away from heat. Use only the compatible pods listed in the same product range, and never charge a damaged device. Keep all parts away from children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
You can order White Gummy FOGER Switch Pro Kit online with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Pay with crypto or a supported gift card and you save 10% on your order total. Orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; below that, shipping is a flat $15, and the minimum order is $100.

Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by USPS or UPS. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so make sure someone of age can receive the parcel.

## Returns and support
Our returns window is 30 days from purchase. Unopened products in their original packaging qualify, refunds are issued through the same payment method that was used for the order, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be accepted. Contact us first so we can send an RMA form. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
